title: Kth Banner Arrangement
description:
## Task

A shop owner has a handful of letter tiles, some of them repeated, and lays them all out in a row to make a banner. List every distinct arrangement (two arrangements are the same when they spell the same string) in ascending dictionary order. Return the one at position `k`, counting from 0, without writing the whole list out: the list can be enormous.

## Input

- `letters` — a string of lowercase letters, the tiles.
- `k` — the 0-based position wanted. It is always valid.

## Output

The arrangement at position `k`, as a string.

## Example

```python
kth_banner_arrangement('aab', 0)  # returns 'aab'
kth_banner_arrangement('aab', 2)  # returns 'baa'
kth_banner_arrangement('abc', 3)  # returns 'bca'
```

## Constraints

- 1 ≤ length of `letters` ≤ 18
- 0 ≤ `k` < the number of distinct arrangements (which may exceed 10^15)
signature: def kth_banner_arrangement(letters: str, k: int) -> str
